extraction.name: DocVQA: A Dataset for VQA on Document Images
extraction.description: A new dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images, consisting of 50,000 questions defined on 12,000+ document images.
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar
extraction.citeAs: Mathew, M., Karatzas, D., & Jawahar, C. V. (2020). DocVQA: A Dataset for VQA on Document Images. arXiv preprint arXiv:2007.00398.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Document images sourced from UCSF Industry Documents Library. Questions and answers collected via a Web-based annotation tool with three stages: question-answer creation, verification, and review.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Hand-picked pages from documents, prioritized pages with tables, forms, lists, and figures; minimized binarized images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three-stage annotation: Stage 1: workers define up to 10 question-answer pairs per image. Stage 2: different workers verify answers and assign question types. Stage 3: authors review mismatches.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: If none of the answers from stage 1 match stage 2, the question is reviewed in stage 3 by authors.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Poor image quality due to binarization; models need improvement on questions requiring understanding of document structure.
